# Surface 26

> Large format porcelain fabrication and installation for walls, showers, fireplaces, floors and countertops. Office in Alpharetta, GA. Serving North Georgia and the Greater Atlanta area.

- Phone: 678.622.0556
- Email: info@surface26.com
- Address: 845 McFarland Pkwy, Alpharetta, GA 30004
- Large format porcelain only. Granite, quartz and quartzite work is referred to our fabrication partner, Surface Providers.

- [Why Us](https://surface26.com/why-us/): Our process, from first call to install, and how we communicate.
- [Why Porcelain](https://surface26.com/why-porcelain/): Fewer grout lines, no sealing, stain and heat resistance, lighter than stone.
- [Gallery](https://surface26.com/gallery/): Representative photos of porcelain walls, showers, fireplaces and counters.
